institutions.name: JMI — Jamia Millia Islamia schools
institutions.route: Class XI school admission / entrance test; check the current school prospectus for each stream.
institutions.eligibility: Class X qualification, stream-wise marks and age rules apply. Check school, stream, category and hostel availability separately.
institutions.expected_window: Not verified for 2027-28. Do not reuse last year's dates.

institutions.name: AMU — Senior Secondary School (Class XI)
institutions.route: Class XI admission test; consult the admission guide for Science and other available streams.
institutions.eligibility: Class X qualification, marks, age and stream-specific requirements apply. School admission is not undergraduate admission.
institutions.expected_window: Not verified for 2027-28. Watch for the new admission guide.

institutions.name: BHU / CHS — Central Hindu Boys' and Girls' Schools
institutions.route: School Entrance Test (SET) for Class XI; consult the bulletin for the relevant school and stream.
institutions.eligibility: Class X qualification and current marks/age criteria apply. Check boys'/girls' school eligibility and available streams. This is SET, not CUET UG.
institutions.expected_window: Not verified for 2027-28. Watch for the new SET bulletin.

institutions.name: JNV — Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas
institutions.route: Class XI Lateral Entry Selection Test (LEST), against vacant seats.
institutions.eligibility: Check district/residence, school location, age and Class X study requirements in the current prospectus. This is not the Class VI or IX test.
institutions.expected_window: Check immediately: the application cycle can precede Class X board results. No deadline is confirmed by this tracker.

institutions.name: Kendriya Vidyalayas — Class XI backup option
institutions.route: Merit / vacancy-based admission, not a general Class XI entrance exam.
institutions.eligibility: Non-KV students depend on vacancies after eligible KV students. Check current stream cut-offs, priorities and the individual school's notice.
institutions.expected_window: Follow the current KVS schedule and local school notices around Class X results; exact dates are not verified.

institutions.name: Ramakrishna Mission Vidyalaya, Narendrapur — Class XI
institutions.route: Higher-secondary admission for selected external students; check the current Class XI selection notice.
institutions.eligibility: Confirm whether external Class X students are being admitted this cycle, gender/residential rules, accepted boards, medium, streams and marks requirements. Old Class XI notices are still on the site.
institutions.expected_window: Not verified for 2027-28. Follow the current official prospectus and counselling notices.

institutions.name: Chandigarh government senior secondary schools — Class XI
institutions.route: Centralised Class XI school/stream allotment and counselling; a non-entrance-test backup route.
institutions.eligibility: Check Class X marks, stream criteria, category rules and preferences for students from Chandigarh schools. Do not assume every seat is available to an out-of-state applicant.
institutions.expected_window: Not verified for 2027-28. Follow the current official prospectus and counselling notices.

institutions.name: Haryana polytechnic colleges — HSTES Diploma Engineering
institutions.location: Haryana; useful for a Delhi NCR shortlist
institutions.route: First-year Diploma Engineering admissions through HSTES merit/counselling, rather than a general entrance test.
institutions.eligibility: Check Class X subjects/marks, domicile, reservation and approved college/branch lists. Choose first-year engineering diploma, not lateral entry or pharmacy; their requirements differ.
institutions.expected_window: Not verified for 2027-28. Follow the current official prospectus and counselling notices.

institutions.name: Uttar Pradesh polytechnic colleges — JEECUP / UPJEE(P)
institutions.route: Polytechnic entrance test followed by counselling. Look for first-year engineering/technology groups that accept Class X.
institutions.eligibility: Check group-specific Class X eligibility, subjects, age, domicile and seat rules in the current brochure. Not every JEECUP group accepts Class X; pharmacy and post-diploma routes differ.
institutions.expected_window: Not verified for 2027-28. Follow the current official prospectus and counselling notices.

institutions.name: Bihar polytechnic colleges — DCECE (PE)
institutions.route: Diploma Certificate Entrance Competitive Examination, Polytechnic Engineering (PE) route and counselling.
institutions.eligibility: Verify Class X qualification, marks, residence/category and medical requirements for PE. Do not confuse PE with PM/PMM or lateral-entry exams, which have different eligibility.
institutions.expected_window: Not verified for 2027-28. Follow the current official prospectus and counselling notices.

institutions.name: PW NSAT — Physics Wallah
institutions.location: PW Vidyapeeth / participating centres and online test options
institutions.route: Coaching admission-cum-scholarship test; separate from Class XI school admission.
institutions.eligibility: Select current Class 10 and confirm the intended next-session course. Verify scholarship components, remaining fees, validity and online/offline conditions.
institutions.expected_window: See the separate PW NSAT hub for a dated 2026 snapshot. Recheck current slots and closing date with PW.
institutions.cycle: Current test cycle for Class 10 students; course/admission year varies

institutions.name: ALLEN TALLENTEX
institutions.location: ALLEN participating centres / offered test modes
institutions.route: Talent-search and coaching scholarship examination; not a school admission test.
institutions.eligibility: Class X has been included in the published eligibility range. Confirm the current cycle, present class, course year and test mode. Online and classroom scholarships may have different conditions.
institutions.expected_window: Current dates not verified: the main portal could not be fetched during this update. Do not use archived cycle dates. Open the official site manually.
institutions.cycle: Current test cycle for Class 10 students; course/admission year varies

institutions.name: Aakash ANTHE — National Talent Hunt Exam
institutions.route: Talent-hunt test for coaching scholarships; cash awards, if offered, have separate conditions.
institutions.eligibility: Class 10 students should select their current class and intended JEE/NEET/Foundation course. Check test-mode differences, fee components, award conditions and scholarship validity.
institutions.expected_window: Check the current ANTHE exam calendar and registration deadline. A test date is not necessarily the application closing date.
institutions.cycle: Current test cycle for Class 10 students; course/admission year varies

institutions.name: Aakash iACST — Instant Admission Cum Scholarship Test
institutions.route: Slot-based coaching admission and scholarship test, distinct from ANTHE.
institutions.eligibility: Class 10 is within the published school-class eligibility range. Check current course/stream criteria, available slots and offer expiry before taking the test.
institutions.expected_window: Slot-based: confirm availability in the official portal rather than assuming one annual exam date. Verify the scholarship acceptance deadline.
institutions.cycle: Current test cycle for Class 10 students; course/admission year varies

institutions.name: Vidyamandir Classes VIQ — Intellect Quest
institutions.route: Coaching admission-cum-scholarship test for JEE, NEET and Foundation preparation.
institutions.eligibility: Class 10 is included in the published school-class range. Select current class, course and test mode; verify centre, fee components, scholarship terms and remaining course cost.
institutions.expected_window: Check the current VIQ schedule and centre/mode options. Archived NAT and VIQ pages can show different cycles; use the current registration notice.
institutions.cycle: Current test cycle for Class 10 students; course/admission year varies
